question: Shijith Nambiar and Parvathy Menon were conferred the 5th Bharat Kala Ratna award for 2020 on 11 December 2021 by Kerala-based Navaneetham Trust for their service to _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Former Kalakshetra faculty membe**r Shijith Nambiar is a masterful **Bharatanatyam performer.**
 
• Shijith Nambiar is a skilled **percussionist **as well.
 
• In** 2007, Bharat Kalachar** awarded him the** "Yuvakalabharathi Title" **for his versatility in Bharatanatyam, Nattuvangam, and choreography.
 
• **Parvathy Menon** received her post-graduate degree in** Bharatanatyam from Kalakshetra.**
 
• She was born and raised in **Kuwait.**
 
• On** December 11, 2021, **Shijith Nambiar and Parvathy Menon received the **5th BHARAT KALA RATNA award for 2020.**
 
• It was given to them by the** Navaneetham Trust of Kerala **for their support of Bharatanatyam.
 
• It is equipped with a** plaque and an rs. 25,000 purse.​​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak:**

 
 
• One of the** eight primary styles **of Indian classical dance is kathak.
 
• It is **Uttar Pradesh's** traditional style of dance.
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj, Lachu Maharaj, Shambu Maharaj, Shovna Narayan, Kumari Kamala, Sunanya Hazarilal Agarwal** are some of the famous kathak dancer from India.
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi:**
 
 
• It comes from the** Andhra Pradesh**, specifically the village of **Kuchipudi.**
 
• A **dance-drama performance** is called Kuchipudi.
 
• Its origins can be found in the **Natya Shastra, an old Hindu Sanskrit scripture.**
 
• **Sobha Naidu, Raja & Radha Reddy, Swapnasundari** are some of the famous kuchipudi dancers of India.
 
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam:**
 
 
• It is a type of classical Indian dance that emerged in popularity in the **state of Kerala.**
 
• **Sunanda Nair, Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma, Jayaprabha Menon, Pallavi Krishnan, Gopika Varma, Vijayalakshmi, Radha Dutta,Rema Shrikant** are some of the famous Mohiniyattam dancers of India.
 
 

f9:T
